response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong open-source and DevOps credentials, but he lacks the core requirement of 8 years of C++ experience (his C/C++ work is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments and a bachelor thesis project), and his career has centered on web/backend/product engineering rather than large-scale cloud compute infrastructure or distributed systems architecture. He has no demonstrated technical leadership role of the scope described (leading platform strategy, mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers) despite senior/staff titles.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, senior-level software engineering experience across multiple domains
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, talks, and open-source project leadership
Hands-on experience with Docker, CI/CD, Kubernetes deployment, and distributed/low-latency systems at Dunnhumby
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months) versus the required 8 years
No direct experience leading a cloud compute platform or large-scale infrastructure at the required scope
Career trajectory is broad full-stack/product engineering rather than deep infrastructure/compute specialization

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform leadership experience
Strong mentoring and open-source technical leadership background
